name: Raptor Thieves
summary: A raptor has stolen the guards' payroll from the Crossroads tower, leaving the defenders baffled. Gazrog calls for a cull to keep the beasts from striking again.

sections.title: A Baffling Heist
sections.body: The Crossroads depends on mercenary and grunt guards to keep trade routes open across the Barrens. Their pay matters to morale and discipline. When silver vanished from the guard tower, leaders expected Centaur raiders or Quilboar scavengers. Instead, a raptor was caught stealing in the dead of night, leaving the settlement stunned and short of coin.

sections.title: Vengeance on the Pack
sections.body: Gazrog does not know why wild beasts would hoard shiny coins, and he has no interest in studying their behavior. The guards are restless without their pay, so he calls for blood and deterrence. He sends hunters to take a dozen raptor heads from across the savannah, hoping to curb the predators' boldness before a full search for the silver begins.

faq.q: Why would raptors steal silver coins?
faq.answer: Even Gazrog admits the theft sounds unbelievable. Raptors are known for keen intelligence and hunting skill, but wild predators are not known to hoard refined currency. Gazrog is more concerned with punishing them before they raid the outpost again.
Gazrog is an orc officer stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He maintains defense and order, overseeing guard logistics, outrunner bounties, and local threats to the Horde's central hub.

faq.q: What was the stolen silver meant for?
faq.answer: The stolen chest held the payroll for the guards defending the Crossroads. Without it, keeping watch across the dangerous Barrens becomes much harder.

faq.q: Where did the theft take place?
faq.answer: The silver was stolen from the guard tower at the Crossroads under cover of darkness. The theft shocked defenders who thought their central post was secure.
Raptor packs roam the central and southern Barrens savannah. Those closer to the Crossroads tend to be less seasoned and easier for travelers to confront.

faq.q: Does this quest recover the stolen silver?
aliases: do i get the silver back
faq.answer: No. Gazrog calls for a punitive cull to kill the offending beasts and thin their numbers. He organizes the search for the stolen coin chest only after the raptor threat is beaten back.

angles.text: The Crossroads is the Horde's logistical spine in Kalimdor. An unpaid or humiliated garrison threatens every caravan crossing the savannah.
As a hunter, you face Barrens raptors known for cunning, pack coordination, and speed. They are formidable targets in the harsh ecology you must master.
